title: TotemChecker
description: TotemChecker checks if you're holding a Totem in your left hand, and if it's not, it displays "Equip Totem." A simple, lightweight mod that helps you remember to equip your Totem in important situations.
body: TotemChecker is a lightweight mod for Fabric that checks if you're holding the Totem of Immortality in your left hand. If it's not, the screen displays "Equip Totem." The mod is simple, undemanding, and helps you never forget your Totem during critical moments in the game. TotemChecker runs in the background, doesn't impact performance, and is easy to use.
